accepted.s: The Special Economic Zone (SEZ) Policy was announced in April 2000 through which policy framework?
accepted.x: The SEZ Policy was announced in April 2000 through the EXIM Policy 2000-01.
accepted.tq: Identify the policy framework associated with the announcement year.
accepted.sec: SEZ policy evolution - EXIM Policy, SEZ Policy 2000, SEZ Act 2005, SEZ Rules 2006

accepted.s:
Consider the following events relating to Special Economic Zones:
1. SEZ Policy announced through the EXIM Policy
2. SEZ Act passed
3. SEZ Act received Presidential assent
4. SEZ Act and SEZ Rules came into force
Which of the following is the correct chronological order?
accepted.x: The SEZ Policy was announced in 2000, the Act was passed in May 2005, assent was given in June 2005, and the Act and Rules came into force on 10 February 2006.
accepted.tq: Arrange the milestones by separating the policy announcement, legislation, assent and commencement.
accepted.sec: SEZ policy evolution - EXIM Policy, SEZ Policy 2000, SEZ Act 2005, SEZ Rules 2006

accepted.s: On which date did the SEZ Act and the SEZ Rules come into force together?
accepted.x: The SEZ Act and the SEZ Rules came into force on 10 February 2006.
accepted.tq: Test the exact commencement date rather than merely the year of enactment.
accepted.sec: SEZ policy evolution - EXIM Policy, SEZ Policy 2000, SEZ Act 2005, SEZ Rules 2006

accepted.s: A principal institutional feature introduced under the SEZ framework is:
o: Mandatory clearance only through the Reserve Bank of India
Single-window clearance for Central and State matters
Separate customs clearance for every unit
accepted.x: The SEZ framework provides single-window clearance for matters involving both the Central and State Governments.
accepted.tq: Match the institutional mechanism with its practical administrative purpose.
accepted.sec: SEZ policy evolution - EXIM Policy, SEZ Policy 2000, SEZ Act 2005, SEZ Rules 2006

accepted.s: Which of the following correctly describes the treatment of a duty-free enclave in an SEZ?
o: It is treated as foreign territory for trade and tariff purposes.
It can import goods only after payment of the basic customs duty.
It is treated as domestic territory for all customs purposes.
It is exempt only from State taxes and not customs duties.
accepted.x: A duty-free enclave is treated as foreign territory for trade and tariff purposes, although it remains within India territorially.
accepted.tq: Apply the special customs-status rule to distinguish legal treatment from geographical location.
accepted.sec: SEZ features - duty-free enclave, developers, minimum area, tax benefits

accepted.s:
An SEZ may be set up by which of the following combinations?
1. Central Government
2. State Government
3. Private persons
4. Joint-sector entities
Select the correct answer using the code given below.
accepted.x: SEZs may be established jointly or severally by the Central Government, State Government or any person, including public, private and joint-sector entities.
accepted.tq: Use an inclusive list and test whether the extreme restriction that excludes private or joint-sector entities is justified.
accepted.sec: SEZ features - duty-free enclave, developers, minimum area, tax benefits

accepted.s: Proposals for setting up SEZs are routed through the State Government to which body for approval?
accepted.x: Proposals for SEZs are routed through the State Government to the Board of Approval.
accepted.tq: Identify the specific approving body rather than a neighbouring economic institution.
accepted.sec: SEZ features - duty-free enclave, developers, minimum area, tax benefits

accepted.s: SEZs under the current framework are described as being predominantly established by which sector?
accepted.x: Although Central, State, public, private and joint-sector entities can establish SEZs, SEZs under the Act are mainly private.
accepted.tq: Distinguish legal eligibility to establish from the predominant ownership pattern.
accepted.sec: SEZ features - duty-free enclave, developers, minimum area, tax benefits

accepted.s: Which one of the following is correctly matched with the SEZ framework?
o: FDI in manufacturing SEZs—prohibited under the automatic route
100% FDI under the automatic route—every activity without exception
FDI in SEZs—permitted only through a constitutional amendment
100% FDI under the automatic route—most manufacturing activities in SEZs
accepted.x: Most manufacturing activities in SEZs permit 100% FDI under the automatic route. The provision is not stated as applying to every activity without exception.
accepted.tq: Reject the absolute claim and retain the qualified investment rule.
accepted.sec: SEZ features - duty-free enclave, developers, minimum area, tax benefits

accepted.s:
With reference to an International Financial Services Centre (IFSC) in an SEZ, consider the following statements:
1. Section 18 of the SEZ Act allows an IFSC in an SEZ.
2. More than one IFSC may be established in the same SEZ under the stated provision.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
accepted.x: Section 18 allows an IFSC in an SEZ, but only one IFSC is permitted per SEZ.
accepted.tq: Test the statutory permission together with its numerical limitation.
accepted.sec: SEZ features - duty-free enclave, developers, minimum area, tax benefits

accepted.s: Under Section 10AA, the income-tax exemption pattern for an eligible SEZ unit is:
o: 100% for ten years followed by complete exemption thereafter
100% exemption for three years and 25% for the next five years
100% for five years, 50% for the next five years, and 50% of reinvested profit for five further years
50% for five years and 100% for the next ten years
accepted.x: Section 10AA provides 100% exemption for the first five years, 50% for the next five years, and 50% of reinvested profit for five additional years.
accepted.tq: Read the tax-benefit slabs in sequence and distinguish duration from percentage.
accepted.sec: SEZ features - duty-free enclave, developers, minimum area, tax benefits

accepted.s: The sunset phase-out of SEZ tax holidays took place during which period?
accepted.x: The tax holidays were phased out during 2017–2020 under the sunset clause.
accepted.tq: Test the policy window using close, ascending year ranges.
accepted.sec: SEZ features - duty-free enclave, developers, minimum area, tax benefits

accepted.s: Under the SEZ (Amendment) Rules, 2025, the minimum land requirement for a semiconductor or electronic-component SEZ was reduced from:
accepted.x: The minimum land requirement for a semiconductor or electronic-component SEZ was reduced from 50 hectares to 10 hectares.
accepted.tq: Compare the old and revised thresholds rather than selecting only the new figure.
accepted.sec: SEZ features - duty-free enclave, developers, minimum area, tax benefits

accepted.s: Which of the following is NOT an objective of the SEZ Act, 2005?
o: Promotion of exports of goods and services
Restriction of domestic and foreign investment
accepted.x: The SEZ Act seeks to promote domestic and foreign investment, not restrict it. Its objectives also include economic activity, exports, employment and infrastructure development.
accepted.tq: Find the option that reverses the direction of a stated policy objective.
accepted.sec: SEZ Act 2005 objectives - which are and which are not

accepted.s:
Consider the following objectives of the SEZ Act, 2005:
1. Promotion of investment, both domestic and foreign
2. Development of infrastructure
3. Promotion of exports of goods and services
4. Creation of employment
Which of the objectives given above are correct?
accepted.x: All four listed objectives are included in the objectives of the SEZ Act. Generation of additional economic activity is another stated objective.
accepted.tq: Recognise the comprehensive policy-objective combination rather than treating employment or infrastructure as exclusions.
accepted.sec: SEZ Act 2005 objectives - which are and which are not

accepted.s: Which of the following is the correct description of a free trade zone?
o: An area reserved exclusively for agricultural exports
An area where goods may be landed, stored, processed and re-exported without customs duty
An area where imported goods must be consumed before re-export
An area where only domestically produced goods may be sold without State taxes
accepted.x: A free trade zone permits goods to be landed, stored, processed and re-exported without payment of customs duty.
accepted.tq: Apply the operational definition by checking all four permitted activities.
accepted.sec: EPZs and free trade zones - first EPZ, Kandla, Falta

accepted.s: Kandla, which became India's first Free Trade Zone, was subsequently converted into a:
o: Coastal Economic Zone under the ADB
National Investment and Manufacturing Zone only
accepted.x: Kandla was India's first Free Trade Zone and was later converted into a Special Economic Zone.
accepted.tq: Separate the earlier institutional designation from the later SEZ status.
accepted.sec: EPZs and free trade zones - first EPZ, Kandla, Falta

accepted.s: Which one of the following pairs is correctly matched?
accepted.x: Falta is an Export Processing Zone in West Bengal. SEEPZ is located in Santacruz, Mumbai, while MEPZ is associated with Chennai.
accepted.tq: Use location-based elimination among similar-sounding export-processing zones.
accepted.sec: EPZs and free trade zones - first EPZ, Kandla, Falta

accepted.s: Which of the following is NOT included among the other Export Processing Zones listed with Noida, Chennai, Cochin and Visakhapatnam?
accepted.x: Noida, Chennai, Cochin and Visakhapatnam are listed Export Processing Zones; Bengaluru is not included in that list.
accepted.tq: Find the geographically plausible but unlisted location.
accepted.sec: EPZs and free trade zones - first EPZ, Kandla, Falta

accepted.s: As on 31 March 2025, how many SEZs were notified and how many were operational?
accepted.x: As on 31 March 2025, India had 368 notified SEZs, of which 276 were operational.
accepted.tq: Distinguish the larger notified stock from the smaller operational stock.
accepted.sec: SEZ performance and criticism - state with most SEZs, exports, Nandigram, Baba Kalyani, DESH

accepted.s: As on 31 March 2025, the number of units operating in SEZs was approximately:
accepted.x: There were 6,695 units operating in SEZs as on 31 March 2025.
accepted.tq: Use place-value discrimination among closely related numerical options.
accepted.sec: SEZ performance and criticism - state with most SEZs, exports, Nandigram, Baba Kalyani, DESH

accepted.s: The investment in SEZs as on 31 March 2025 was approximately:
accepted.x: The reported investment in SEZs was ₹7,82,192 crore as on 31 March 2025.
accepted.tq: Test digit grouping and distinguish crore-scale values.
accepted.sec: SEZ performance and criticism - state with most SEZs, exports, Nandigram, Baba Kalyani, DESH

accepted.s: What was the approximate employment generated in SEZs as on 31 March 2025?
accepted.x: SEZs accounted for approximately 31,77,893 jobs as on 31 March 2025.
accepted.tq: Check the Indian-numbering format and reject misplaced zeroes.
accepted.sec: SEZ performance and criticism - state with most SEZs, exports, Nandigram, Baba Kalyani, DESH

accepted.s: SEZ exports in FY 2024–25 were approximately:
accepted.x: SEZ exports in FY 2024–25 were reported at approximately ₹14,63,669 crore, equivalent to about US$173 billion.
accepted.tq: Match the reported export figure with its correct crore magnitude.
accepted.sec: SEZ performance and criticism - state with most SEZs, exports, Nandigram, Baba Kalyani, DESH

accepted.s: Which one of the following was identified as a criticism of the performance of SEZs?
o: SEZs received more than half of total foreign direct investment.
Domestic tariff area sales were completely unrestricted.
SEZs received less than 3% of foreign direct investment.
No SEZ units were shut during the five-year period.
accepted.x: SEZs received less than 3% of FDI. Other criticisms included capped DTA sales and the closure of many units.
accepted.tq: Select the qualified performance criticism and reject reversed or absolute statements.
accepted.sec: SEZ performance and criticism - state with most SEZs, exports, Nandigram, Baba Kalyani, DESH

accepted.s:
Which of the following statements regarding the recent slowdown in SEZs is correct?
1. 466 units shut down in five years across seven SEZs.
2. 100 units shut down in FY 2024–25.
3. Export growth was below 4% in FY 2024–25.
Select the correct answer using the code given below.
accepted.x: All three statements describe reported indicators of the SEZ slowdown: 466 closures across seven SEZs, including 100 in FY 2024–25, and export growth below 4%.
accepted.tq: Combine multiple performance indicators and watch for the complete-code option.
accepted.sec: SEZ performance and criticism - state with most SEZs, exports, Nandigram, Baba Kalyani, DESH

accepted.s: The Baba Kalyani Committee, constituted in 2018, recommended renaming SEZs as:
accepted.x: The committee recommended renaming SEZs as 3Es—Employment and Economic Enclaves.
accepted.tq: Discriminate among closely similar expansions of an official abbreviation.
accepted.sec: SEZ performance and criticism - state with most SEZs, exports, Nandigram, Baba Kalyani, DESH

accepted.s: Which of the following was NOT a recommendation associated with the Baba Kalyani Committee?
o: Complete abolition of SEZs without replacement
Separate rules for manufacturing and services
accepted.x: The committee recommended separate rules, extension of the sunset clause and a unified IFSC regulator. Complete abolition of SEZs was not the stated recommendation.
accepted.tq: Identify the option that changes reform and restructuring into outright abolition.
accepted.sec: SEZ performance and criticism - state with most SEZs, exports, Nandigram, Baba Kalyani, DESH

accepted.s: The DESH Bill, announced in the Union Budget 2022–23, seeks to:
o: Create a new Export Processing Zone at Kandla
accepted.x: The Development of Enterprise and Services Hubs (DESH) Bill was announced in Budget 2022–23 to replace the SEZ Act, but it remains pending.
accepted.tq: Match the proposed legislation with the law it is intended to replace.
accepted.sec: SEZ performance and criticism - state with most SEZs, exports, Nandigram, Baba Kalyani, DESH

accepted.s:
Which of the following changes is associated with the proposed DESH Bill?
1. Removal of the positive Net Foreign Exchange condition
2. Permission for Domestic Tariff Area sales
3. Immediate replacement of the SEZ Act through an enacted law
Select the correct answer using the code given below.
accepted.x: The DESH proposal removes the positive NFE condition and allows DTA sales. It remains pending and has not immediately replaced the SEZ Act.
accepted.tq: Separate proposed provisions from the legal status of a Bill that is still pending.
accepted.sec: SEZ performance and criticism - state with most SEZs, exports, Nandigram, Baba Kalyani, DESH

accepted.s: The Nandigram protests of 2007 were associated with opposition to land acquisition for a:
o: Free Trade Warehousing Zone at Kandla
accepted.x: Nandigram in West Bengal witnessed violent protests in 2007 against land acquisition for a chemical-hub SEZ.
accepted.tq: Link the place and year to the specific project that triggered the conflict.
accepted.sec: SEZ performance and criticism - state with most SEZs, exports, Nandigram, Baba Kalyani, DESH

accepted.s: Which corridor is correctly matched with its States and partner country?
o: DMIC—Delhi, Uttar Pradesh, Haryana, Rajasthan, Madhya Pradesh, Gujarat and Maharashtra—Japan
DMIC—Tamil Nadu, Karnataka and Andhra Pradesh—United Kingdom
CBIC—Punjab, Haryana, Uttarakhand, Uttar Pradesh, Bihar, Jharkhand and West Bengal—Japan
accepted.x: The Delhi–Mumbai Industrial Corridor covers Delhi, Uttar Pradesh, Haryana, Rajasthan, Madhya Pradesh, Gujarat and Maharashtra, with Japan as partner.
accepted.tq: Start with the sure corridor-country pair and verify the State cluster.
accepted.sec: Industrial corridors → states covered and partner country

accepted.s: The Delhi–Mumbai Industrial Corridor is aligned with which dedicated freight corridor?
accepted.x: The DMIC runs along the Western Dedicated Freight Corridor.
accepted.tq: Associate the corridor with its defining transport alignment.
accepted.sec: Industrial corridors → states covered and partner country

accepted.s:
Consider the following pairs:
1. CBIC—Tamil Nadu, Karnataka and Andhra Pradesh
2. CBIC—Japan through JICA
3. CBIC node in Andhra Pradesh—Krishnapatnam
Which of the pairs given above are correct?
accepted.x: CBIC covers Tamil Nadu, Karnataka and Andhra Pradesh, is associated with Japan through JICA, and has Krishnapatnam as its Andhra Pradesh node.
accepted.tq: Check the corridor, partner institution and State-specific node together.
accepted.sec: Industrial corridors → states covered and partner country

accepted.s: The Amritsar–Kolkata Industrial Corridor covers which group of States?
o: Punjab, Haryana, Uttarakhand, Uttar Pradesh, Bihar, Jharkhand and West Bengal
Tamil Nadu, Karnataka and Andhra Pradesh
Delhi, Gujarat, Maharashtra, Madhya Pradesh and Rajasthan
accepted.x: The AKIC covers Punjab, Haryana, Uttarakhand, Uttar Pradesh, Bihar, Jharkhand and West Bengal.
accepted.tq: Identify the full contiguous State group rather than a partial corridor list.
accepted.sec: Industrial corridors → states covered and partner country

accepted.s: The Amritsar–Kolkata Industrial Corridor is associated with which transport infrastructure?
o: Western Dedicated Freight Corridor and coastal shipping only
Southern Dedicated Freight Corridor and NW-5
Eastern Dedicated Freight Corridor and inland waterways of NW-1
accepted.x: The AKIC is associated with the Eastern Dedicated Freight Corridor and inland waterways along National Waterway-1.
accepted.tq: Match the corridor’s geography with its supporting transport infrastructure.
accepted.sec: Industrial corridors → states covered and partner country

accepted.s: Which one of the following pairs is correctly matched?
accepted.x: The Bengaluru–Mumbai Economic Corridor covers Karnataka and Maharashtra and has the United Kingdom as partner.
accepted.tq: Use the partner-country clue to distinguish similar corridor abbreviations.
accepted.sec: Industrial corridors → states covered and partner country

accepted.s:
Which of the following statements about the Visakhapatnam–Chennai Industrial Corridor is correct?
1. It is approximately 800 km long.
2. Andhra Pradesh is the State covered in the listed corridor description.
3. It is associated with the Asian Development Bank.
4. It is India's first coastal corridor.
Select the correct answer using the code given below.
accepted.x: VCIC is approximately 800 km long, covers Andhra Pradesh in the stated description, is associated with ADB and is India's first coastal corridor.
accepted.tq: Use the complete-code option when all geographic, numerical and institutional features align.
accepted.sec: Industrial corridors → states covered and partner country

accepted.s: The East Coast Economic Corridor extends from:
accepted.x: The East Coast Economic Corridor extends from Kolkata to Kanyakumari.
accepted.tq: Distinguish the endpoints of similarly named national corridors.
accepted.sec: Industrial corridors → states covered and partner country

accepted.s: Which statement correctly describes the relationship between ECEC and VCIC?
o: VCIC is the first phase of ECEC.
VCIC and ECEC are both phases of DMIC.
ECEC is the first phase of VCIC.
ECEC is a partner country of VCIC.
accepted.x: The Visakhapatnam–Chennai Industrial Corridor is the first phase of the East Coast Economic Corridor.
accepted.tq: Test the direction of the phase-to-parent-corridor relationship.
accepted.sec: Industrial corridors → states covered and partner country

accepted.s: The Andhra Pradesh node of the Hyderabad–Bengaluru Industrial Corridor is located at:
accepted.x: Orvakal is the Andhra Pradesh node of the Hyderabad–Bengaluru Industrial Corridor.
accepted.tq: Separate State-specific nodes belonging to different industrial corridors.
accepted.sec: Industrial corridors → states covered and partner country

accepted.s: Which one of the following is correctly matched?
accepted.x: The Hyderabad–Bengaluru Industrial Corridor covers Telangana, Andhra Pradesh and Karnataka.
accepted.tq: Match the corridor abbreviation with its exact State coverage.
accepted.sec: Industrial corridors → states covered and partner country

accepted.s: How many industrial corridors are included under the National Industrial Corridor Development Programme?
accepted.x: The National Industrial Corridor Development Programme includes 11 industrial corridors.
accepted.tq: Test the programme-wide count using close numerical distractors.
accepted.sec: Industrial corridors → states covered and partner country

accepted.s: The integrated East Coast Industrial Corridor, proposed in Budget 2026–27, includes a node at:
accepted.x: Budget 2026–27 proposed an integrated East Coast Industrial Corridor with a node at Durgapur.
accepted.tq: Distinguish the newly specified node from existing corridor nodes.
